settings.heading: How to Use & Ingredients
settings.content:
Spray 2–3 pumps onto your pillow, blanket, or into the air before bedtime. Avoid spraying directly onto skin or face. For best results, shake gently before each use.

Our spray contains only two ingredients: purified water and natural lavender oil. Capacity: 30 ml.

Store in a cool, dark place to preserve the quality and scent of the oil over time.

settings.heading: Why Lavender Works
settings.content:
A Scent Rooted in Ancient Rituals

Used for thousands of years from ancient Egypt to Roman baths, lavender has long been treasured for its calming aroma and therapeutic power. Once reserved for royalty and sacred rites, it was believed to purify the air, ease the mind, and promote restful sleep. Today, its legacy lives on as one of nature’s most trusted remedies for relaxation.

What Makes Lavender So Effective?

Naturally Calming: Lavender’s essential oil contains linalool and linalyl acetate—compounds scientifically shown to reduce stress and support deeper sleep.

Gentle on the Senses: Unlike synthetic fragrances, pure lavender oil delivers a soft, floral scent that soothes without overwhelming—perfect for nightly use.

Time-Tested and Trusted: From ancient apothecaries to modern wellness rituals, lavender remains a go-to for emotional balance and restful nights.

A Ritual Worth Repeating

Our Lavender Spray distills this powerful tradition into a simple bedtime ritual. With just a few spritzes, you bring centuries of botanical wisdom into your space—helping your body and mind unwind, night after night. Lavender isn’t just a scent—it’s serenity in a bottle.

settings.text: The Lavender Sleep Spray transforms your bedtime into a soothing ritual with just a few spritzes. Powered by pure lavender oil and crafted for calm, it helps you relax, unwind, and drift off faster naturally. No pills, no side effects just instant peace of mind and restful nights, night after night.

Formulated with only two ingredients purified water and natural lavender oil our spray delivers clean, effective relaxation without fillers or synthetic fragrances. Safe for nightly use and gentle on skin, it’s a minimalist formula with maximum impact.
